# QuotePilot design specification

Concept generated with the built-in ImageGen tool: `compare-concept.png` (1536×1024). Prompt: complete professional QuotePilot supplier-comparison dashboard, navy fixed sidebar, warm-white workspace, restrained cobalt accents, white tables, highlighted recommended column, three summary statistics, stacked cost breakdown and decision insight. Include navigation to Welcome, Quotations, Compare suppliers, Decision results; English/Chinese switching; no fabricated reliability ratings or decorative raster art.

Tokens: background #f7f8fa, navy #0c1e3c, text #142039, blue #2460dc, muted #69768b, border #dfe5ed, highlight #edf4ff; 12px panel radius, 7px controls; 224px sidebar; 14px base text, 29px page headings, 17px panel headings, 12–13px table and control type. System sans-serif stack. Custom consistent 24px outline SVG icons, 1.7px strokes. All graphics are code-native charts and icons, no raster artwork.

Components: fixed sidebar and slim topbar; page heading with actions; project context; three horizontal KPI panels; full-width comparison table; two-column chart/insight region. Responsive sidebar becomes horizontal navigation, panels stack, and wide data tables scroll within their own containers.

Required workflow extensions: editable purchase basket; quote editor and import mapping/review dialogs; evidence fields; priority sliders and optional delivery cutoff; export menu and backup restore. They reuse the same controls, panels, tables and typography.

Intentional deviations from generated mockup: replace internally inconsistent illustrative figures with computed values ($1,636.42 and $146.77); add basket-match status and edit-basket action to prevent inequivalent comparisons; label savings baseline explicitly; use MY workspace initials rather than a fabricated user's identity; retain privacy indicator as static text, not a nonfunctional menu. Recommendation copy uses actual normalized weights and never calls unverified supplier reliability proven.
